    Full convergence summary for a gibbs_postscm fit

    convergence_summary.Rd

    Combines trace plots, ESS, posterior summaries, and optionally Gelman-Rubin R-hat into a single printed report. Mirrors the convergence assessment described in the paper.

    convergence_summary(
  fit,
  gdata = NULL,
  sampler_fn = NULL,
  package = NULL,
  run_rhat = FALSE,
  n_chains = 4L,
  n_iter = 1000L,
  burn_in = 500L,
  control = NULL,
  min_ess = 200,
  rhat_thresh = 1.1,
  show_traces = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    fit

    Output from gibbs_postscm(). Required.

    gdata

    Prepared data object. Required only if run_rhat = TRUE.

    sampler_fn

    The sampler function. Passed to compute_rhat(). Defaults to gibbs_postscm if found, otherwise supply explicitly.

    package

    Character. Name of the package to load inside each worker when run_rhat = TRUE, so that sampler dependencies are available in parallel worker sessions. E.g. package = "scmBayesPost". Only needed when run_rhat = TRUE. Default NULL.

    run_rhat

    Logical. Run multi-chain R-hat? Default FALSE.

    n_chains

    Passed to compute_rhat(). Default 4.

    n_iter

    Passed to compute_rhat(). Default 1000.

    burn_in

    Passed to compute_rhat(). Default 500.

    control

    Passed to compute_rhat().

    min_ess

    ESS adequacy threshold. Default 200.

    rhat_thresh

    R-hat convergence threshold. Default 1.1.

    show_traces

    Logical. Display trace plots? Default TRUE.

    Value

    Invisibly returns a list with elements: $ess data frame from compute_ess() $posterior_summary data frame of means and 95% credible intervals $rhat data frame from compute_rhat() (only if run_rhat = TRUE)
